title: Arc Mainnet Launches With Full BitGo Wallet and Custody Support
summary: Clients can deposit and withdraw USDC on Arc through BitGo, with indexing support for both native and token transfers. EURC will also be supported on Arc.
body_markdown:
## Key Takeaways


-


BitGo wallet infrastructure, Self-Custody MPC (hot and cold), Custody MPC, and Go Account, support Arc from mainnet launch on September 16, so clients can custody and settle on the network.


-


Clients can deposit and withdraw USDC on Arc through BitGo, with indexing support for both native and token transfers. EURC will also be supported on Arc.


-


Gas Tank, BitGo’s gas automation product, covers gas costs during auto-consolidation on Arc, so treasury teams do not need to hold or manage a separate gas balance.


As institutional stablecoin activity grows, so does demand for infrastructure designed for predictable, dollar-denominated fees and fast finality. Purpose-built settlement networks for stablecoins are one response to that demand.


Arc, an open, EVM compatible Layer-1 network built by Circle, is one of the more closely watched entrants into that space. It uses USDC as native gas and is designed to provide predictable, dollar-denominated transaction fees and sub-second deterministic finality. From day one, Arc brings together USDC as native gas, local fiat stablecoins, tokenized assets, programmable Bitcoin, and leading onchain applications into one connected ecosystem.


For institutions already running custody and treasury operations through BitGo, the real question is how fast they can put capital to work on a new network without changing how they operate day to day. BitGo is a Day 1 partner on Arc, and wallet, deposit, and withdrawal support is live from mainnet launch.


## What’s live on Arc through BitGo


Clients get the same wallet infrastructure on Arc that they already use elsewhere on BitGo:


-


[Self-Custody](https://www.bitgo.com/products/self-custody/) MPC, in both hot and cold configurations, and[Custody MPC](https://www.bitgo.com/products/custody-wallets/)


-


[Go Account](https://www.bitgo.com/products/go-account/)


-


USDC deposits and withdrawals, with indexing support for both native and token transfers, and


-


EURC support


## How consolidation and gas work on Arc


BitGo also supports auto-consolidation and bulk withdrawal on Arc, the same as on BitGo’s other supported chains. Gas Tank covers the gas costs generated during auto-consolidation, so a treasury team does not have to fund or monitor a separate gas wallet to keep consolidation running.


If you want to start moving USDC on Arc,[get in touch with your BitGo representative](https://calendly.com/d/crmk-p2t-k78) .


## Frequently asked questions


### How is BitGo supporting Arc from day one?


BitGo’s wallet infrastructure, deposit and withdrawal support, and Gas Tank automation are available on Arc starting at mainnet launch on September 16. Clients with an existing BitGo wallet do not need a separate onboarding step to start using Arc.


### Which BitGo wallet types work on Arc?


Self-Custody MPC, in both hot and cold configurations, Custody MPC, and Go Account all support Arc at mainnet launch.


### Can I move USDC and EURC on Arc through BitGo?


Yes. USDC deposits and withdrawals are supported, with indexing for both native USDC transfers and token transfers. EURC will also be live on Arc.


### Does Gas Tank work on Arc?


Yes. Gas Tank covers gas costs generated during auto-consolidation on Arc, the same way it does on BitGo’s other supported chains, so treasury teams do not need to hold or top up a separate gas balance.


### Do I need to do anything to start using Arc?


If you already have an active BitGo wallet, no additional setup is required. You can start transacting once Arc mainnet is live on September 16. If you are not yet a BitGo client,[contact us to get onboarded](https://calendly.com/d/crmk-p2t-k78) .
